# BrandStrip

92px atmospheric sidebar header: lockup on the left, character insignia on the right, texture behind.

```jsx
<BrandStrip character="engineer" />
<BrandStrip character="engineer" collapsed />
```

- `collapsed` swaps the lockup for the 40px mark, centred in the 72px rail.
- The texture is the character atmosphere image plus a bottom scrim; it never carries meaning.
